name: Dranzer GT
description: Dranzer GT: a Balance phoenix with two unique abilities and one Special.

ability.name: Giga Turbo Engine
ability.description: Using Charge grants 1 Turbo stack. Maximum 3 Turbo stacks. Each stack increases ATK by 6%. Each stack reduces stamina consumption by 5%. Stacks expire after 3 rounds without gaining another.

special_move.name: Giga Phoenix Explosion
special_move.description: Base damage: 165 + 70% ATK. Consumes all Turbo stacks. Each consumed stack increases Special damage by 12%. At 3 stacks, ignores 18% enemy DEF. Cooldown: 4 rounds.

abilities.name: Giga Turbo Engine
abilities.description: Using Charge grants 1 Turbo stack. Maximum 3 Turbo stacks. Each stack increases ATK by 6%. Each stack reduces stamina consumption by 5%. Stacks expire after 3 rounds without gaining another.

abilities.name: Overheat Reactor
abilities.description: Activates at 3 Turbo stacks. Successful Attacks deal 18% additional damage. Attacks consume 1 additional stamina while active.
